fields.name: metadataStateKey
fields.label: Metadata state key
fields.hint: Stores {search, title, description, location, author, links, ...} under this key.

fields.name: saveAssets
fields.label: Save asset
fields.hint: Saves the image to the frame's assets folder. auto follows the frame's save-assets setting.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Unsplash",
  "description": "Random Unsplash photo",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "settings": ["unsplash"],
  "fields": [
    { "name": "search", "type": "string", "value": "nature", "label": "Search", "placeholder": "e.g. nature, birds" },
    {
      "name": "orientation",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "auto",
      "options": ["auto", "any", "landscape", "portrait", "squarish"],
      "label": "Orientation"
    },
    {
      "name": "metadataStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "label": "Metadata state key",
      "hint": "Stores {search, title, description, location, author, links, ...} under this key."
    },
    {
      "name": "saveAssets",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "auto",
      "options": ["auto", "always", "never"],
      "label": "Save asset",
      "hint": "Saves the image to the frame's assets folder. auto follows the frame's save-assets setting."
    }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }],
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "inputEnabled": true, "durationEnabled": true, "duration": "900" }
}

clock.name: Clock
clock.description: The current time as text, in the frame's time zone

fields.markdown: Tokens in braces: `{year/4}` `{year/2}` `{month}` `{month/2}` `{month/n}` `{month/n/3}` `{day}` `{day/2}` `{weekday}` `{weekday/3}` `{weekday/2}` `{hour}` `{hour/2}` `{hour/ap}` `{hour/2/ap}` `{am/pm}` `{minute}` `{minute/2}` `{second}` `{second/2}` `{tzName}`; anything else is written as it is.
